_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base-rate coil (score rarely moves ±2 in 12h) plus no breaker inside 24h; outflows are supportive but not yet a directional trigger.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD/CAUTION coil; narrative implies constructive accumulation without a hard directional call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound and composite score holds inside Anxiety (39-46) over next 12-24h
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break moving score ±2 or more — F&G through ~25 with funding negative, or squeeze with decisively positive ETF flows
